messages.message:
Patch Set 3:

(11 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The main one is whether `zpool wait -t free` actually waits for anything when an OST object is destroyed. If it doesn't, the only real effect is a 5s sleep per OST and the OOM will most likely keep happening. Separately, the ZFS 2.4.4 bump in lbuild duplicates https://review.whamcloud.com/68847 and probably belongs there rather than in a test-only workaround.

Some concerns, see inline comments. The main one is that the low-memory ZFS exclusion for test_56b is dropped before the fix has been shown to work, which puts a known OOM crash back into every ZFS session.

Abandoned

commit.message:
LU-20276 tests: Reclaim space before/after running sanityn test

test_56b causes OOM in test_70/71 in 1/40 run since
using ZFS 2.4. This patch add function 'zfs_wait_free_osts'
to reclaim free space in function 56a and 56b before they
end.

This patch also enables test_56b. To check if OOM is
triggered after zfs_wait_free_osts function.

This patch bumps ZFS version to 2.4.4
